system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: we carefully designed four role-specific prompts that reflect the reasoning flow of SKU mapping: reasoning generation, deknowledge evaluation, factual retrieval, and final decision making.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent prompts filled with base/candidate product names.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Zero-Shot Inference: GPT-4o directly predicts product equivalence from raw product names without additional context.
env_context_strategy.note: Input is only the product pair; web search retrieves external facts, not environment/repo context.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The output is a JSON object with a concise "thinking" field describing attribute ambiguity and a "questions" array for structured follow-up queries.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The output is a JSON object with a concise "thinking" field describing attribute ambiguity and a "questions" array for structured follow-up queries.
tool_call_format.note: Paper does not describe a tool-calling API; agents emit structured JSON consumed by the pipeline.

tool_count.evidence_quote: the Knowledge Agent executes focused web queries and synthesizes authoritative answers into structured outputs
tool_count.note: Only web search is described as a tool.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Q2K integrates: (1) a Reasoning Agent that generates targeted disambiguation questions, (2) a Knowledge Agent that resolves them via focused web searches, and (3) a Deduplication Agent
edit_primitive.note: No file editing in this SKU-mapping pipeline.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Q2K operates through the collaboration of 3 specialized agents: (1) a Reasoning Agent, (2) a Knowledge Agent, (3) a Deduplication Agent, and followed by a final decision stage
protocol_standardization.note: No protocol (MCP/A2A) mentioned anywhere in the paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Q2K operates through the collaboration of 3 specialized agents: (1) a Reasoning Agent, (2) a Knowledge Agent, (3) a Deduplication Agent, and followed by a final decision stage that integrates all evidence to determine SKU equivalence.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the Reasoning Agent decomposes each product-pair comparison into targeted, attribute-specific questions
planning_granularity.note: Question decomposition, but no plan object or planning stage.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Q2K explicitly decomposes the mapping task into three coordinated agents

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: If the evidence is insufficient, the agent escalates to the full Reasoning–Knowledge process

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: a human-in-the-loop mechanism enhances Q2K by validating low-confidence cases, with corrections fed back into the reasoning database for continuous improvement

short_term_state.evidence_quote: each Qi is a concatenated sequence of disambiguation questions and Ai is its corresponding validated answer set
short_term_state.note: Question/answer evidence sets carried through the pipeline.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: This concatenated query string is embedded using a sentence transformer and compared against the repository of previously stored reasoning traces.
long_term_memory.note: Q-A Trace DB persists across runs and is re-injected.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The Deduplication Agent subsequently evaluates whether the retrieved traces provide sufficient information gain to support equivalence reasoning.
self_verification.note: Sufficiency check is over retrieved traces, not a verification of the agent's own output; human validation is coded in C5.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: a final decision-making stage that integrates all available signals
retry_policy.note: Single pass; no task-level retry described.

rollback.evidence_quote: outputs a binary decision ( 1 = same SKU, 0 = different SKU)
rollback.note: No environment mutation to roll back.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: After evidence aggregation, Q2K performs a final decision-making stage that integrates all available signals
termination_condition.note: Closest concept: run ends after the decision stage; no allowed termination value matches, so treat as not reported.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: By reusing retrieved reasoning instead of issuing repeated searches, Q2K balances accuracy with efficiency
cost_controls.note: Reasoning-trace reuse acts as a semantic cache.

network_policy.evidence_quote: the Knowledge Agent executes focused web queries and synthesizes authoritative answers into structured outputs
network_policy.note: Unrestricted web access implied; no network policy described.

permission_model.evidence_quote: For each generated question qi∈Q , the Knowledge Agent executes focused web queries

tracing.evidence_quote: This stage preserves interpretability through explicit evidence citation.
tracing.note: Question–answer reasoning traces stored in QDB.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: we report accuracy as the primary evaluation metric
eval_hooks.note: Artifact repo ships code and sample datasets; evaluation protocol described but runner not confirmed.

guardrails.evidence_quote: This conservative evaluation enforces factual consistency and minimizes redundant searches.
guardrails.note: No safety filters or action policies described.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Identifying whether two product listings refer to the same Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) is a persistent challenge in e-commerce

open_source.evidence_quote: The code and sample datasets used in this study are publicly available at: https://github.com/viralpick/paper-q2k-artifact.
